dict.string: MeetingIntro needs access to your calendars to monitor upcoming meetings and trigger countdown reminders.
MeetingIntro needs access to your calendars to monitor upcoming meetings and trigger countdown reminders.
MeetingIntro uses your Focus status to silence voice reminders and audio alerts while you're in Do Not Disturb.
MeetingIntro records your microphone alongside meeting audio when Auto-Record is enabled, so you can review what was said after the meeting.
MeetingIntro captures meeting audio playback via ScreenCaptureKit. No video is recorded — audio only.
